Maria G: Quick proposal — run an e2e matched-harness compare across three model variants to isolate kernel selection, batching heuristics, and KV cache behavior. Goals: identical prompts, identical decode params, identical stop sequences, tokenizer alignment, compare replay vs synthetic.
Ajay K: +1. Please add a tokenizer equivalence check early. We should run `python tools/tokenizer_check.py --model path --prompts prompts.txt` and diff token ids.
Linh T: Note: batching padding changes kernel path for small batches. Run experiments with `batching.continuous=true/false` and target_batch_sizes=[1,4,8,16]. Measure p50/p95 latency and kernel switch count.
Diego R: Also capture KV cache hit/miss rates and average KV size per request. Add tracepoints: `kv.alloc`, `kv.hit`, `kv.fallback`. Perf trace snippet:
```
TRACE: kv.hit=1234 kv.miss=56 kv.alloc_bytes=12MB
```
Zoe L: Remember last regression where model compiled with seq_len=1024 fallbacked to generic kernel for 2048 inputs. Pin `compile.max_seq=2048` in harness or we get mismatched kernels. :warning:
PerfBot: Scheduled run created: run_id=rid_2026_03_17_01, fixtures=synthetic_10k,replay_2k. Results will be posted to /runs/rid_2026_03_17_01.
Maria G: Plan: 1) tokenizer parity pass 2) small synthetic smoke 3) full synthetic 10k (3 traffic shapes) 4) replay 2k. Config snippet:
```
--decode_temp=0.2 --top_p=0.95 --stop_sequences='["\\n\\n"]' --seed=42
--batching.continuous=true --target_batch=[4]
```
Maria G: Logging: per-request JSONL with fields: model, kernel, batch_size, seq_in, seq_out, kv_hit, latency_ms. Put in s3://redwood-perf/e2e_matches/rid_2026_03_17_01/
Ajay K: I'll own tokenizer parity. Will drop token-diff logs to the run dir and a short script to re-encode.
Linh T: I'll drive batching matrix and collect kernel switch counts. Expect ~2 days to finish runs on ci-perf pool. :calendar:
Diego R: I'll hook profiler and KV counters. If we see >5% fallback kernel rate we need to stop and triage.
Zoe L: +1 to stop on >5% fallback. Also check deterministic seeds — some old models had nondet decoding in beam sampling.
Maria G: ack. Let's reconvene after runs complete. ETA Tue 03/23. /cc @here
